**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Environment**
This plugin only does something on Android, so these details decide whether
the report can be reproduced at all:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin version | [e.g. 8.0.0] |
| `@capacitor/core` version | [e.g. 8.5.3] |
| Android version / API level of the device | [e.g. Android 16, API 36] |
| `compileSdkVersion` of your application | [e.g. 36] |
| `targetSdkVersion` of your application | [e.g. 36] |
| Android Gradle Plugin version | [e.g. 8.13.0] |
| Kotlin version | [e.g. 2.2.20] |
| Build system | [e.g. Android Studio 2026.2.2 / Gradle 9.8.2] |

The last four matter because the plugin is compiled by the application's own
Kotlin toolchain. If you see `Class 'kotlin.Unit' was compiled with an
incompatible version of Kotlin`, include the exact message and every version
above.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: [e.g. macOS 26.7.2]
 - Android Studio version: [e.g. 2026.2.2]

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**
 - Device: [e.g. Pixel 10]
 - Android version: [e.g. Android 16]

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
